title: 第一卷 第15章 李若雪第一卷 第16章 正人君子
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: 翌日清晨，林逸早早起床，来到院中。
九亩灵田在晨光中翠绿一片，青灵护田阵的光罩若隐若现。
他蹲下身，仔细检查阵盘的运转情况，灵石又黯淡了些许。
“每月得消耗一块灵石维护，加上借贷了，护道税，一大家人的日常开销，压力真不小啊！”
林逸深吸一口气，感叹道。
仙路上，处处要钱。
所有的安宁，都是需要花钱来保障。
提升修为，提升战力，培养族人，花费就更多了。
“得赶快赚钱才行！”
林逸回到厢房静室，取出符纸朱砂，开始制作金甲符。
凌霜那边还等着要，而且金甲符利润比火锥符高出一大截。
铺开符纸，研磨朱砂，提笔凝神。
黑色狼毫笔落下，灵力流转。
第一张，失败。
第二张，失败。
第三张，成功，普通品质。
林逸眉头紧皱，手感不太对。
他咬牙坚持，一连画了几天，两百张符纸耗尽，只成了七十张金甲符。
上佳品质四十张，普通三十张，没有一张绝佳。
“这成功率，才三成五！”
“比火锥符差远了！”
“问问刘铭，这到底怎么回事？”
林逸带着灵符，来到万宝阁。
“林老哥，这是金甲符？”
“上佳四十张，六十枚碎灵一张，普通三十张，四十枚碎灵一张，加起来三千六百枚碎灵，三块六下品灵石！”
“你都能制作一品中等灵符了！”
“进境真是神速！”
刘铭接过符，一张张察看后，不由笑着夸赞道。
“别夸了！”
“两沓符纸，两盒朱砂，成本四块下品灵石，我还是亏钱的！”
林逸眉头紧皱，摇头叹道。
“第一次制作金甲符，接近保本，很不错了！”
“而且，你用的都是一品下等符纸和朱砂，本来制符成功率就很低！”
“制作金甲符，需要用一品中等符纸和朱砂，成功率才能得到保障！”
刘铭笑着提醒道。
“原来是这样！”
“一品中等符纸和朱砂，多少钱？”
林逸连忙问道。
“一沓中等符纸，两块灵石一沓，一盒中等朱砂，两块灵石一盒，一百张成本四块灵石！”
刘铭笑着回应道。
“成本是原来的两倍了！”
“平均下来，一张灵符的成本，要四十枚碎灵！”
content_en:
The next morning, Lin Yi got up early and came to the courtyard.
The nine-acre spiritual field is green in the morning light, and the light shield of the Qingling Field Protector Formation is looming.
He squatted down and carefully checked the operation of the formation disk. The spirit stone dimmed a little again.
"You have to consume one spiritual stone every month for maintenance, plus the loans, the protection tax, and the daily expenses of a large family, it's really a lot of pressure!"
Lin Yi took a deep breath and sighed.
On the road to immortality, money is needed everywhere.
All peace requires money to ensure.
Improving your cultivation, improving your combat power, and cultivating your clansmen will cost even more.
“We have to make money quickly!”
Lin Yi returned to the quiet room of the wing, took out the talisman paper and cinnabar, and began to make the golden armor talisman.
Ling Shuang is still waiting for it, and the profit of the Golden Armor Talisman is much higher than that of the Fire Cone Talisman.
Spread out the talisman paper, grind the cinnabar, pick up the pen and concentrate.
The black wolf brush fell, and spiritual power circulated.
The first one failed.
The second one failed.
The third one, success, ordinary quality.
Lin Yi frowned, feeling something wasn't right.
He gritted his teeth and persisted. After drawing for several days, the two hundred talisman papers were exhausted and only became 70 golden armor talismans.
Forty of the best quality, thirty of the average, none of them excellent.
"This success rate is only 35%!"
"It's far worse than the Fire Cone Talisman!"
"Ask Liu Ming, what's going on?"
Lin Yi brought the magic talisman to Wanbao Pavilion.
"Brother Lin, is this the Golden Armor Talisman?"
"Forty excellent ones, one with sixty broken spirits, thirty ordinary ones, and one with forty broken spirits. That adds up to 3,600 broken spirits, and three low-grade spirit stones!"
"You can even make a first-grade medium-level spiritual talisman!"
“The entry is really fast!”
Liu Ming took the talisman, looked at it one by one, and couldn't help but smile and praise.
"Stop boasting!"
"Two stacks of talisman paper, two boxes of cinnabar, costing four low-grade spiritual stones, I still lost money!"
Lin Yi frowned, shook his head and sighed.
“It’s the first time I’ve made a golden armor talisman, and it’s close to breaking even. It’s pretty good!”
"Moreover, you are using first-grade low-grade talisman paper and cinnabar, so the success rate of making talismans is very low!"
"To make the golden armor talisman, you need first-grade medium talisman paper and cinnabar, so the success rate can be guaranteed!"
Liu Ming reminded with a smile.
"So that's it!"
"How much does it cost for a medium-grade talisman paper and cinnabar?"
Lin Yi asked quickly.
"A stack of medium talisman papers, a stack of two spiritual stones, a box of medium cinnabar, two spiritual stones in a box, one hundred sheets cost four spiritual stones!"
Liu Ming responded with a smile.
“The cost is twice as much!”
"On average, the cost of one spiritual talisman is forty broken spirits!"
